name: Completion Duck
description: Lowers the level song during the completion jingle so a custom endStart.ogg is easier to hear.

music-percent.name: Level Song Volume
music-percent.description: How loud the level song remains while the completion jingle plays.

fade-down-seconds.name: Fade Down Time
fade-down-seconds.description: How quickly the level song smoothly fades down after completing the level.

hold-seconds.name: Quiet Hold Time
hold-seconds.description: How long the song remains quiet before beginning to fade back up.

fade-up-seconds.name: Fade Back Time
fade-up-seconds.description: How slowly the level song smoothly returns to its original volume.
